## Bug report

GoalDist, GoalAlign, PathDist and PathAlign measured distance straight through lethal and inscribed cells. This makes the best scoring trajectory the one going through obstacles when the obstacle is between robot and goal and the robot got stuck against it.

This is because the [propogateManhatanDistances()](https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/blob/94bace6f7bcf60ecfc17cd3a97155657c3c249aa/nav2_dwb_controller/dwb_critics/src/map_grid.cpp#L103) used MapGridCritic's [validCellToQueue](https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/blob/94bace6f7bcf60ecfc17cd3a97155657c3c249aa/nav2_dwb_controller/dwb_critics/src/map_grid.cpp#L52) which always returns true.

I took the after video with a fix which runs bfs which skips adding neighbors which are lethal, inscribed or no information ().
This was just a quick fix I came up with claude to validate the root cause. but seems like behaviour improves a lot after this change.

example fix: https://github.com/Nisarg236/navigation2/pull/1


Before: robot was getting stuck in this case where goal is on other side of obstacle


[stuck_robot.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/82f321a4-cfa8-4424-9d1e-00c0dbb01bfc)



After: robot is not getting stuck


[not_stuck.webm](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c33fb9ff-faa9-4e0a-822d-c088b1bf5704)
